SELECT r.raceId, r.name, r.date, res.fastestLapTime 
FROM results AS res 
JOIN races AS r ON res.raceId = r.raceId 
WHERE res.position = 1 AND r.year = 2009 
ORDER BY r.date ASC 
LIMIT 1
